note: What every shape, wire and Film field on the board means. Nothing here is authored for the book: each entry cites where in the tree the definition already lives, and build.mjs refuses if a Film emits a field this file does not explain (P32) or the board draws a role or edge kind it does not name (P33). Each field is marked state (what it is doing this epoch) or built (read once when the world was built) — FORGE_SEMANTIC_IR_v1_MEASURE.md §1.3 and WRL/learn.html §4.

Pulser.is: a clock; the only source of signal
Pulser.then: Every signal on the board starts at one of these. Nothing else can make one.

Relay.is: a pass-through, so signal can travel
Relay.then: One arrives, any number leave — a relay that fans out is the board's router.

Door.is: a sink; signal arrives and stops
Door.then: It latches what reached it and passes nothing on. A door is where a path ends.

Spinner.is: rotation: takes signal, drives a pose
Spinner.then: The only object on the board that holds a value a claim can rewrite — and only if its config says configurable.

Orb.then: It is driven, never driving: an orb is what you watch to see whether anything happened.

Ledger.is: not a WRL role — the book's own drawing of the receipts in the epoch's Film
Ledger.then: It counts what the run admitted, and turns red on a Rejected outcome.

SignalWire.is: signal: a sig_out to a sig_in
SignalWire.then: Legal from a Pulser or Relay, into a Relay, Door or Spinner. This is how the board moves.

SocketControl.is: control: a socket to a pose
SocketControl.then: Legal only from a Spinner into an Orb. At most one may land on any input port — fan-in is a typed refusal.

cur.is: the signal on this wire in this epoch

nxt.is: the signal it will be carrying in the next one

open.is: the gate in this epoch — 1 means signal reached it and it latched

next_open.is: what the gate becomes next epoch (open′ = next_open)

cur_out.is: what this relay is putting out in this epoch

next_out.is: what it will put out next epoch — the OR of its incoming wires (cur_out′ = next_out)

rotor.is: the rotation it is holding right now: runtime state, one hex lane per quaternion component, not configuration

config.is: fixed or configurable — whether a claim is allowed to rewrite its rotor

pose.is: the orientation it is holding right now, in the same four lanes

controller.is: the spinner that drives it. Exactly one, always

fault.is: the sticky numeric-fault latch: once 1 it stays 1 until a claim resets it

w.is: lane width in bits — geometry, fixed when the world was built

n.is: how many lanes — geometry, fixed when the world was built

policy.is: the numeric policy the forge reduced under. Same id on every object of a run

quat4.is: a flag: those lanes are a four-component quaternion

mode.is: periodic (fires on a cycle) or once (fires one epoch and is done)

p.is: the period: it fires every p epochs

phase.is: the offset within that period at which it fires

armed.is: 0 in every Film on this site — 389 of 389 pulser lines measured. A pulser arms at commit and is consumed at react, so it is never armed at the boundary a Film is taken at

done.is: a once clock that has already fired

nf.is: epochs until it next fires; −1 means a once clock that has fired and never will again

field_source: TRVM/forge/film.py (the emitter), TRVM/forge/forge_state.py (nf, derived from the decoded counter and never from t), TRVM/forge/lower_e2a.py (the commit/react law), TRVM/FORGE_SEMANTIC_IR_v1_MEASURE.md §1.3

kinds.state: What it is doing in this epoch. The forge derived every one of these; none of them is in the world document.
kinds.built: How the object was made, read once when the world was built. These do not change as the film runs.
